name: The Impossible Show
flavor: The whole tent disappears. In its place: whatever you need everyone to believe is standing here instead - a burning building, a bottomless pit, an army that was never hired.
description:
You remake a piece of the world. A 60-foot cube within range fills with a fully realised illusory environment — sight, sound, temperature, even scent — and it can be anything you can picture: a collapsed tunnel, a wall of roaring fire, a chasm where the floor used to be, a cheering crowd of a hundred phantom performers. It needs no concentration and holds for the duration while you do whatever else you like.

**While the illusion stands unexposed it behaves like the thing it depicts.** It blocks line of sight through it, and its area is difficult terrain to any creature entering or crossing it — nobody walks briskly through a rockfall they believe in. It is still an image: it deals no damage, stops nothing that does not care what it sees, and supports no weight.

**Exposing it is one action for one creature, and it ends for everybody.** A creature can spend its action to study the illusion and make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}}; a creature that deliberately shoves through it may make that check as part of the movement, since contact gives the game away. On any success the illusion is revealed for **every** creature at once — it does not go on fooling the ones who failed — and it loses its line-of-sight and terrain effects for the rest of the duration, though the image remains.

**Once during the duration**, as a bonus action, you can make the whole thing enact a single dramatic moment: the phantom army charges, the fire roars up, the floor gives way. If the illusion has not been exposed, every creature of your choice inside it or within 10 feet of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}} or be frightened of it until the end of its next turn and, if it has a reaction available, use that reaction to move as far from the illusion as its speed allows.
narration: The tent is gone. In its place is a rockfall, or a fire, or a drop into nothing — and it is not a picture of one, it is cold on your face and loud in your ears and entirely in the way. It stays there while you walk off and do something else.
sheetSummary: Once per combat. Action, 120 ft, 60-ft cube, costs 3 Phantasm, up to 10 minutes, no concentration. While unexposed it blocks line of sight and is difficult terrain. Any creature can spend its action (or push through it) to make an Investigation check vs {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}}; ANY success exposes it for everyone and ends those effects. Once during the duration, bonus action: if still unexposed, creatures of your choice inside or within 10 ft make a Wisdom save vs {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}} or are frightened until the end of their next turn and must use a reaction to flee it. Deals no damage.
